request_arithmetic: minimum 2 agent requests per sample = 24; this task shape runs about 5 first-role calls (4 tool rounds + handoff) and 2 decider calls, so about 84 requests for 12 samples; the cap adds ~43% headroom for retries and empty responses. The uncompressed arm issues no summary requests.
stop_line: connection-class error (APIConnectionError/APITimeoutError/connection error/insufficient balance/rate limit/authentication error)
failure_policy: preserve and count every failure and cap-limited sample

per_call: verbatim text of the first call of each role
per-call new-frame characters and provider input/output tokens
per_sample: payload_sha256 over the recorded payload block
tool trace, handoff line, final answer, judge verdicts

freeze_sha256_note: per the r15 discipline this freeze is immutable; any revision requires a *_FREEZE_AMENDMENT_<date>.json recording what changed, why, and the old and new SHA256, and the batch manifest records this freeze file's own SHA256
